title: Eval harness per control: accuracy, exception recall, consistency, cost and a CI gate
scenario: The MFH audit committee wants numbers before ControlPilot tests CM-03 at year end. Two reviewers labeled 30 sampled changes; the agent ran 5 times per sample with recorded outputs, tokens and latency. A cheaper prompt v4 is proposed. Build the harness that scores both and decides whether v4 may ship, keyed on exception recall because a missed exception is the costly error.
task: Implement run-level accuracy and exception precision/recall per attribute and overall
Measure consistency across 5 runs: modal agreement and Fleiss kappa
Compute cost per 100 samples with cached-token pricing and p50/p95 latency
Build the report and a regression gate against the accepted baseline; interpret v3 vs v4
acceptance: Metrics match hand-computed values, including ties, empty slices and incomplete runs
Missing runs and unlabeled samples are reported, not silently dropped
The CLI passes v3 and blocks v4 with exit code 1
ANSWER.md explains the decision with attribute-level numbers and statistical caveats
